    Realizations go to distinguished triangles: splitting off the X-parts #

    A realization A → B → C of δ in C_J decomposes, through B ≅ N ⊞ (X_A ⊞ X_C), as the direct sum of the realization A_B → N → C_B between interval parts and the split sequence X_A → X_A ⊞ X_C → X_C. The first goes to a distinguished triangle by the X-free case, the second to a split triangle, and the image of the realization is isomorphic to their direct sum.
